neighbours.label: Academic citation and referencing conventions: text about citation styles (APA, MLA), reference lists, quoting and paraphrasing sources
fire: Most term papers close with a page headed "Works Cited," which is put after the final paragraph.
This guide shows how to write an APA citation for a book with two authors.
In Chicago style, the bibliography is arranged by the authors' last names.
When you paraphrase a source, you still need an in-text citation with the page number.
The tutor checked whether each reference followed the MLA format.
A reference list in APA style gives the year right after the author's name.
Footnotes in this journal must follow the Chicago citation style, with full titles.
Remember to cite every source you quote, and list all of them under "References" at the end.
quiet: Most cookbooks close with a page headed "Desserts," which is put after the final chapter.
This guide shows how to write a strong opening for a speech with two parts.
In the school choir, the singers are arranged by the pitch of their voices.
When you revise a draft, you still need a clear topic sentence in each paragraph.
The tutor checked whether each paragraph followed the main argument.
A cover letter in a formal tone gives the reason for writing right after the greeting.
Essays in this class must follow the five-paragraph outline, with full sentences.
Remember to proofread every page you write, and read all of it aloud at the end.
